action.command:
cd /workspace && docker rm -f open_taki_test >/dev/null 2>&1
cat > /workspace/tika.yml <<'EOF'
services:
  tika:
    image: codeberg.org/kosmos-eu/open_taki:latest
    networks:
      opencloud-net:
    restart: always
    volumes:
      - ./taki-config.yaml:/etc/open_taki/config.yaml:ro
    ports:
      - "9998:9998"
    logging:
      driver: ${LOG_DRIVER:-local}

networks:
  opencloud-net:
EOF
docker compose -f /workspace/tika.yml up -d 2>&1 | tail -8
sleep 6
docker compose -f /workspace/tika.yml ps 2>&1
